params.prompt: Hey what's the best tool for ai avatars
params.intro1: It really depends on what you're trying to do, because “AI avatars” has split into a few different categories.
params.intro2: For **most creators and marketers**, here's how I'd rank them today:
params.row1Why: Most natural facial expressions, lip sync, gestures, voice cloning and localization. Benchmark for talking head videos.
params.row2Why: Better collaboration, SCORM, compliance, team workflows; less creator-focused.
params.row3Why: Extremely fast mobile workflow and social editing. Great for Reels creators.
params.row4Why: Interactive avatars that can hold live conversations.
